data.rationale: The proposal covers only a fragment of the Allrecipes search step (a consent click, then a click and type in the search box). It leaves out the OpenTable and Notes steps and the cross-tab synthesis, and it has no parameters, no Enter keypress, no recipe selection, and a vague "div" click, so it can't be automated into the true workflow.
